stem: A cricket club in Lahore played 40 matches last season and won 26 of them. This season, the club has won each of its first 10 matches. For all 50 of these matches combined, what percent of the matches did the club win?
solution: Divide by the 50 matches: \(\frac{36}{50} = 0.72\), which is \(72\%\).
verify:
v = Rational(26 + 10, 40 + 10) * 100
assert v == 72
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == v
